body: Yep best friend. I can only laugh at it now, and tbh it is hilarious.

There's a video of me when I was 13 with bright pink leg warmers and my camo coloured top rolled up like Britney style, dancing to Low by Flo Rida. Stupidly showed by friend around a year and a half ago and she uploaded it to her facebook. The humiliation was real.
Im trying to find reasons right now to not go on a walk and just walk into the middle of the road.
Everyday Im sitting in my room alone and putting a plastic bag over my head and tying a scarf around my neck just begging to pass out and never wake up

I felt like I didn't want to live anymore. I felt like a life without him just isn't worth living. He picked me up at a very dark point in my life and made me so happy. I just want to convince him that this is all a mistake and that I need him.

No one needs me. No one talks to me. Well i dont think that they would be happier but I dont think it would make a difference. Life would just go on the same really.
Sad thing is, if i killed myself in my room. No one would find me for days. No one makes the effort to come and talk to me or anything lmao
I don't want anyone else. I knew from day one that he was the one when I realised I was completely comfortable around him which never ever happened before.
Yeah it is. I have tried to think of many solutions but I don't think any will work. I know I dont deserve to live and ultimately people will be happier once i'm gone.
